description: Deadlock questions solved like Silberschatz ch. 7: with `max`, the banker's algorithm (need matrix, is the state safe, a safe sequence and every check of Work against Need); add `request` to decide whether a request is granted, must wait, would be unsafe, or exceeds the declared need. With `requestMatrix` instead, deadlock detection: which processes are deadlocked now. Each step says why a process can or cannot run.

allocation.description: Allocation matrix, one row per process, one column per resource type

available.description: Available vector, one per resource type

max.description: Max matrix (banker). Same shape as allocation

request.description: With max: a request to evaluate, e.g. {process:"P1", vector:[1,0,2]}

resources.description: Resource names. Default A, B, C…

name: os_banker
